title: SDARE-BENCH: Evaluating Large Language Models on Conversational Stigma Detection and Response in Dyadic and Group Dialogue

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the SDARE-Bench dataset by testing LLMs on detecting stigma components (stereotypes, prejudice, discrimination) and assessing their open-ended conversational responses in dyadic and multi-speaker group dialogues concerning physical and mental health conditions (e.g., Autism, Depression, Diabetes).
